title: IVG Pro 12 Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Fizzy Cherry IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods offer a sweet, juicy Cherry flavour with a sparkling finish inspired by fizzy confectionery. The flavour balances bold fruit with a playful tang, creating a smooth and satisfying vape with a lively twist. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 0mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once clicked together, the refill system keeps the pod topped up as you vape — no refilling, no coil changes, and up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. With mesh coil technology and a click-to-fit setup, these pods are designed for smooth MTL vapour and easy assembly with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
